
```{r scrambling opto bouts data}

set.seed(1234)

pfn.bouts.stats.scrambled = pfn.sparc.bout.stats

trials = names(table(pfn.bouts.stats.scrambled$Replicate)) 

for(i in c(1:length(trials))){
  
  subset.inds = which(pfn.bouts.stats.scrambled$Replicate == trials[i])
  
  curr.trial = pfn.bouts.stats.scrambled[subset.inds,]
  
  curr.trial$Angular = sample(curr.trial$Angular, replace = FALSE)
  curr.trial$Translational = sample(curr.trial$Translational, replace = FALSE)
  curr.trial$Absolute_angular = sample(curr.trial$Absolute_angular, replace = FALSE)
  
  pfn.bouts.stats.scrambled[subset.inds,] = curr.trial
  
}

scrambled.summary.ang = summarySE(data = pfn.bouts.stats.scrambled,
                                  measurevar = "Angular",
                                  groupvars = c("Time"),
                                  na.rm = TRUE)

scrambled.summary.trans = summarySE(data = pfn.bouts.stats.scrambled,
                                  measurevar = "Translational",
                                  groupvars = c("Time"),
                                  na.rm = TRUE)

scrambled.summary.abs.ang = summarySE(data = pfn.bouts.stats.scrambled,
                                  measurevar = "Absolute_angular",
                                  groupvars = c("Time"),
                                  na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r append pfn anatomy}

pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R = NA
pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L = NA
pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R = NA
pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L = NA
pfn.sparc.stats$deltaNOaminusd = NA

for(i in c(1:nrow(pfn.sparc.stats))){
  
  curr.rep = as.numeric(strsplit(pfn.sparc.stats$Replicate[i],"Fly")[[1]][2])
  curr.rep = paste("Fly",curr.rep,sep=" ")
  curr.anat.info = pfn.sparc.anatomy[which(pfn.sparc.anatomy[,1]==curr.rep),]
  
  #pfn.sparc.stats
  if(nrow(curr.anat.info)==1)
  {
    pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R[i] = curr.anat.info$`R NO 2 signal`
    pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L[i] = curr.anat.info$`L NO 2 signal`
    pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R[i] = curr.anat.info$`R NO 3 signal`
    pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L[i] = curr.anat.info$`L NO 3 signal`
    
    pfn.sparc.stats$deltaNOaminusd[i] = curr.anat.info$`NO2R vs NO3L ratio`
  }

}


pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R[which(pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R <0)] = 0
pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L[which(pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L <0)] = 0
pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R[which(pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R <0)] = 0
pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L[which(pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L <0)] = 0

```


```{r delta NO inds}

pfn.sparc.stats$deltaNOd = (pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R-pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L)/(pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R+pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L)
pfn.sparc.stats$deltaNOa = (pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R-pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L)/(pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R+pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L)
pfn.sparc.stats$deltaNOaminusd = (-pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R+pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L+pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R-pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L)/(pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R+pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L+pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R+pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L)

```

```{r stats}

deltaNOad_cor = cor(pfn.sparc.stats$delta_angular_velocity,pfn.sparc.stats$deltaNOaminusd,method = "pearson",use="complete.obs")
deltaNOd_cor = cor(pfn.sparc.stats$delta_angular_velocity,pfn.sparc.stats$deltaNOd,method = "pearson",use="complete.obs")
deltaNOa_cor = cor(pfn.sparc.stats$delta_angular_velocity,pfn.sparc.stats$deltaNOa,method = "pearson",use="complete.obs")

delta_NOaminusd_lm = lm(delta_angular_velocity ~ deltaNOaminusd, data = pfn.sparc.stats)
#summary(delta_NOaminusd_lm)

delta_NOd_lm = lm(delta_angular_velocity ~ deltaNOd, data = pfn.sparc.stats)
#summary(delta_NOd_lm)

delta_NOa_lm = lm(delta_angular_velocity ~ deltaNOa, data = pfn.sparc.stats)
#summary(delta_NOa_lm)
```

```{r confidence intervals}

attach(pfn.sparc.stats)

# Define new data point(s)
minus_one_to_one <- data.frame(deltaNOaminusd = c(-1, 1),
                               deltaNOd = c(-1,1),
                               deltaNOa = c(-1,1))

# Calculate confidence intervals for the mean response
deltaNOaminusd_CI_prediction = predict(delta_NOaminusd_lm, newdata = minus_one_to_one, interval = "confidence",level=0.95)
deltaNOa_CI_prediction = predict(delta_NOa_lm, newdata = minus_one_to_one, interval = "confidence")
deltaNOd_CI_prediction = predict(delta_NOd_lm, newdata = minus_one_to_one, interval = "confidence")


#deltaNOaminusd_CI_prediction$x = c(-1,1)

deltaNOaminusd_CI_prediction = data.frame(x=c(-1,1),lwr=deltaNOaminusd_CI_prediction[,2],upr=deltaNOaminusd_CI_prediction[,3],fit=deltaNOaminusd_CI_prediction[,1],ymax=c(-1,1),group=c("lower","upper"))

deltaNOd_CI_prediction = data.frame(x=c(-1,1),lwr=deltaNOd_CI_prediction[,2],upr=deltaNOd_CI_prediction[,3],fit=deltaNOd_CI_prediction[,1],ymax=c(-1,1),group=c("lower","upper"))

deltaNOa_CI_prediction = data.frame(x=c(-1,1),lwr=deltaNOa_CI_prediction[,2],upr=deltaNOa_CI_prediction[,3],fit=deltaNOa_CI_prediction[,1],ymax=c(-1,1),group=c("lower","upper"))

```

```{r NO a minus d scramble control}

n_scrambles =  10000

cor_values = c()

for(i in c(1:n_scrambles)){
  
  set.seed(i)
  
  scramble = sample(c(1:nrow(pfn.sparc.stats)))
  
  scrambled_NO2_L = pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L[scramble]#runif(nrow(pfn.sparc.stats), min = 0, max = 1)
  scrambled_NO2_R = pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R[scramble]#runif(nrow(pfn.sparc.stats), min = 0, max = 1)
  scrambled_NO3_L = pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L[scramble]#runif(nrow(pfn.sparc.stats), min = 0, max = 1)
  scrambled_NO3_R = pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R[scramble]#runif(nrow(pfn.sparc.stats), min = 0, max = 1)
  
  scrambled_deltaNOa = (scrambled_NO3_R - scrambled_NO3_L)/(scrambled_NO3_R + scrambled_NO3_L)
  scrambled_deltaNOd = (scrambled_NO2_R - scrambled_NO2_L)/(scrambled_NO2_R + scrambled_NO2_L)
  
  scrambled_deltaNOa_cor_sign = sign(cor(pfn.sparc.stats$delta_angular_velocity, scrambled_deltaNOa,method = "pearson",use="complete.obs"))
  scrambled_deltaNOd_cor_sign = sign(cor(pfn.sparc.stats$delta_angular_velocity, scrambled_deltaNOd,method = "pearson",use="complete.obs"))
  
  scrambled_deltaNOad = (scrambled_deltaNOa_cor_sign*(scrambled_NO3_R - scrambled_NO3_L) + scrambled_deltaNOd_cor_sign*(scrambled_NO2_R - scrambled_NO2_L))/(scrambled_NO3_L+scrambled_NO3_R+scrambled_NO2_L+scrambled_NO2_R)
  
  scrambled_deltaNOad_cor =  cor(pfn.sparc.stats$delta_angular_velocity, scrambled_deltaNOad,method = "pearson",use="complete.obs")
  
  scrambled_deltaNOad_lm =  lm(pfn.sparc.stats$delta_angular_velocity ~ scrambled_deltaNOad)
  
  cor_values = append(cor_values,scrambled_deltaNOad_cor)
  
}

deltaNOd_versus_shuffle = data.frame(correlation = cor_values,seed = c(1:n_scrambles))

#hist(cor_values,n=100)

length(which(cor_values > deltaNOad_cor))

```

```{r scrambled control for comparing correlation changes over time}

set.seed(1234)

x = pfn.sparc.bout.stats
x$Angular = sample(x$Angular, replace = FALSE)

experiments = names(table(x$Replicate))

activation.frames = as.numeric(names(table(x$Time)))
activation.frames = activation.frames[which(activation.frames > 20 & activation.frames < 40)]
activation.frames = as.character(activation.frames)

pre.aves = subset(x, subset = Time <= 20)
pre.aves = summarySE(data = pre.aves, measurevar = "Angular",groupvars = c("Replicate"))


cors = c()

for(i in c(1:length(activation.frames))){
  
  curr.frames = activation.frames[c(1:i)]
  
  activated.aves = subset(x, subset = Time %in% curr.frames)
  activated.aves = summarySE(data = activated.aves, measurevar = "Angular", groupvars = c("Replicate"))
  
  #data.temp = data.frame(experiment = NA, delta_ang_vel = NA, deltaNOaminusd = NA)
  
  delta.NO = c()
  delta.ang.vel = c()
  
  for(j in experiments){
    
    pre.aves.sub = subset(pre.aves, Replicate == j)
    activated.aves.sub = subset(activated.aves, Replicate == j)
    
    curr.delta.ang.vel = activated.aves.sub$Angular - pre.aves.sub$Angular
    curr.delta.NO = experiment.deltano$deltaNOaminusd[which(experiment.deltano$experiment == j)]
    
    delta.NO = append(delta.NO, curr.delta.NO)
    delta.ang.vel = append(delta.ang.vel, curr.delta.ang.vel)
    
  }
  
  curr.cor = cor(delta.NO,delta.ang.vel, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
  
  cors = append(cors, curr.cor)
  
}

cor.over.time.data.scrambled = data.frame(stimulus_duration = activation.frames, correlation = -cors)


```

```{r experimenting with weighing deltaNO}

weights = seq(-1,1,0.001)
#weights = c(0)

cors = c()
off.cors = c()

for (i in weights) {
  
 # deltaNO2minus3 = ((1+i)*(pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R - pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L) + (1-i)*(pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L  -  pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R))/((1+i)*(pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R + pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L)+(i-1)*(pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R + pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L))
  deltaNO2minus3 = -((1-i)*pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R + (1+i)*pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L -(1-i)*pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L - (1+i)*pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R) / ((1-i)*pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_R+(1-i)*pfn.sparc.stats$NO2_L+(1+i)*pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_R+ (1+i)*pfn.sparc.stats$NO3_L)
  
  
  cors = append(cors,cor(deltaNO2minus3,pfn.sparc.stats$on_angular_velocity,method = "pearson",use="complete.obs"))
  off.cors = append(off.cors,cor(deltaNO2minus3,pfn.sparc.stats$off_angular_velocity,method = "pearson",use="complete.obs"))
  
}

cor.plot.data = data.frame(correlation = cors,weights = weights,light_off_correlation = off.cors)

ymax = max(c(cors,off.cors),na.rm=TRUE)
ymin = min(c(cors,off.cors),na.rm=TRUE)

max.delta = weights[which(cor.plot.data$correlation==max(cor.plot.data$correlation))]


ggplot(cor.plot.data,aes(x=weights,y=correlation,color=weights))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = max.delta,size=0.8,linetype="dashed", col= 'black')+
  geom_line(size=1.5)+
  scale_color_scico(palette = "roma",limits =c(-1,1))+
  ylim(c(ymin,ymax))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line(size = 1,linetype = "solid"),
        axis.line.x = element_line(size = 1, linetype = "solid"),  
        axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold",size=15),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold",size=15))


ggplot(cor.plot.data,aes(x=weights,y=light_off_correlation,color=weights))+
  geom_line(size=1.5)+
  scale_color_scico(palette = "roma",limits =c(-1,1))+
  ylim(c(ymin,ymax))+
  theme_minimal()+

        axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold",size=15),
```

```{r}
  geom_rect(data = data_rect, inherit.aes = FALSE, aes(xmin = on,xmax =off, ymin = 0, ymax = 0.6),
            color="transparent",
            alpha = 0.3,
            fill = "#f194a3")+
  geom_line()+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x=Time,ymin = Translational-se,ymax = Translational+se),alpha=0.3)+
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dashed","solid"))+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line(size=1,linetype = "solid"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face="bold",size=15),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold",size=15),
        legend.position = "none")


setwd(output_dir)

ggsave(PFNa_bulk_translational_line_plot,file="PFNa bulk translational velocity line plot.svg",width=8,height=4)
ggsave(PFNd_bulk_translational_line_plot,file="PFNd bulk translational velocity line plot.svg",width=8,height=4)
  

```
